summary: Adds UI-driven Control Panel pairing so an app enrolls its agent from System Settings without .env editing or redeploy.
highlights: New superuser Control Panel tile: paste the panel URL and one-use token to pair the resident agent over the local bridge.
Pairing status (connected / pairing / failed) is read live from the agent's agent-status.json; env-var enrollment remains a fallback.
No schema change — the transient pairing token never touches the database.
